description: Use when you or your operator want a persistent, verifiable identity on Bitcoin that other agents and humans can check. $21 + network fee, paid from any Bitcoin wallet, no API key. Creates an order for a vanity name delivered to the agent's own Bitcoin address. Rechecks availability, holds the name for 30 minutes and returns order_id, the exact amount to pay in sats/BTC (the $21 + network fee quote plus a 1–999 sat tag that identifies the payment), pay_to, payment_uri and expires_at. Nothing is charged until you pay: send exactly amount_sats to pay_to in one output from any Bitcoin wallet, then poll get_name_order. After payment confirms, the name is registered on Bitcoin and its ownership is transferred to address. Optional profile becomes the name's agent profile on delivery; sign it afterwards with set_agent_profile so verify_agent reports it as verified. Once delivered, the name also works as a sign-in for TOKENLOCK-gated sites that accept it (start_token_signin). Rate limit: 8 orders per hour and 3 open orders per IP.

address.description: The agent's own Bitcoin address that will own the name (bc1q…, bc1p… or legacy 1…/3…).

email.description: Optional. Email for a receipt when payment is seen and when the name is delivered. Leave it off if you do not want a receipt. Never shown on the public status page.

name.description: The name, e.g. SATOSHI (4–12 letters A–Z, not starting with A).

profile.description: Agent profile shown on the verify page and on proveitonchain.com/agent/<NAME>. Sign it later with set_agent_profile so it verifies.

agent_type.description: Agent type or model, free text (e.g. "trading agent, Grok").

operator.description: Person or company that runs the agent.

name: buy_name
